title: A warm measure requires no ownership

captions.emotions: Feeling attachment and an unspoken expectation

meaning: Your open warmth can remain free when manageable help turns gratitude into neither compulsory availability nor a claim on someone.
text: Warmth can be sincere while still touching fear of losing importance. In the physical position of Anahata, Temperance expresses care through actions combining different needs without either disappearing. The Sun in energy brings a wish to share open attention and make an encounter simple and friendly. The Devil in emotions offers attachment, an unspoken expectation and worry about an independent step. Help may feel tender while changing its amount feels difficult. Care preserves freedom when a pleasant atmosphere does not become a condition for agreeing to every proposal or abandoning a personal limit.

For example, one person helps the other prepare a small gathering at home while reserving later time for a personal activity. Everything feels warm, but an expectation appears that the helper will now stay all evening. **Pleasant involvement does not make a personal limit inadequate closeness.** Thanks can be given while an agreement remains. Warmth stays in a freely accepted contribution rather than paying for a good mood through cancelled plans.

Fear of losing a response can hide behind claims about a kind shared evening. A manageable measure becomes hidden debt, and joy requires convenient behaviour. Alternatively, worry withdraws help entirely. Care preserves a clear request and permission to decline a condition. Wanting more time together can be said directly without a contribution granting authority over a person.
